text.en: Clients describe the salon team as exceptionally kind, patient, and dedicated. Pet parents frequently mention individual groomers like Katrina and Rainer by name, noting they spend unhurried time getting to know each dog's habits and sending reassuring progress updates throughout grooming visits.

title.en: Gentle comfort for anxious rescue dogs

text.en: Reviewers emphasize how remarkably comfortable their nervous and rescue dogs feel during appointments. Pet owners report that stylists take special care with shy pups and senior dogs, sitting with them in pens and ensuring they remain calm and stress-free from drop-off to collection.

title.en: Meticulous cuts and clean fragrant coats

text.en: Dog owners are thrilled with the finished appearance of their pets, highlighting even trims, soft coats, and fresh scents. Clients note that stylists follow reference pictures accurately, producing neat haircuts for doodles, maltipoos, and older dogs that leave coats looking tidy and healthy.

q.en: Is Philly Floof Grooming recommended for anxious or timid dogs?

a.en: Yes, pet owners consistently commend the stylists for their patient handling of nervous dogs, taking extra time to ease pet anxiety.

q.en: How does the salon house pets during grooming sessions?

a.en: The salon utilizes both pens and individual crates; owners desiring pen accommodation are advised to request this during drop-off.

q.en: Can owners request a specific groomer at the salon?

a.en: Yes, clients regularly request preferred stylists by name, including Katrina and Rainer, who have loyal followings among local dog owners.

q.en: What payment methods are accepted at Philly Floof?

a.en: The parlour accepts both credit cards and cash for grooming services.
